summary: A medium dialog containing an invite form with name, email and role fields and a Send invite button disabled until name and email are filled.
use: Short create or invite flows that collect a few fields without leaving the page.
spec: Fields stacked in `<Stack gap="3.5">`: two `<TextField` (Full name, Email with `type="email"`) using `bind:value={name}` and `bind:value={email}`
`<Select label="Role" bind:value={role} options={roleOpts}` with three options: Admin, Editor, Viewer
`{#snippet actions()}`: ghost Cancel and filled Send invite with `disabled={!name || !email}`
